name: Giant Scorpion
description: A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail.

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

abilities.name: Venomous Stinger
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to deal 1d4+4 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
